SELECT
    COALESCE(json_extract_scalar(payload, '$.supplierName'),
             json_extract_scalar(payload, '$.supplierId')) AS supplier,
    SUM(CAST(json_extract_scalar(payload, '$.amount') AS DOUBLE)) AS total_matched_amount
FROM aerospace_events.domain_events
WHERE domain = 'ERP'
  AND event_type = 'INVOICE_MATCHED'
GROUP BY
    COALESCE(json_extract_scalar(payload, '$.supplierName'),
             json_extract_scalar(payload, '$.supplierId'))
ORDER BY total_matched_amount DESC

SELECT
    json_extract_scalar(payload, '$.supplierName') AS supplier_name,
    SUM(CAST(json_extract_scalar(payload, '$.amount') AS DOUBLE)) AS total_matched_amount
FROM aerospace_events.domain_events
WHERE domain = 'ERP'
  AND event_type = 'INVOICE_MATCHED'
GROUP BY json_extract_scalar(payload, '$.supplierName')
ORDER BY total_matched_amount DESC

SELECT
  json_extract_scalar(payload, '$.cellId') AS production_cell,
  COUNT(*) AS work_orders_started
FROM aerospace_events.domain_events
WHERE domain = 'MES'
  AND event_type = 'WORK_ORDER_STARTED'
GROUP BY json_extract_scalar(payload, '$.cellId')
ORDER BY work_orders_started DESC

SELECT
  json_extract_scalar(payload, '$.productionCell') AS production_cell,
  COUNT(*) AS work_orders_started
FROM aerospace_events.domain_events
WHERE domain = 'MES'
  AND event_type = 'WORK_ORDER_STARTED'
GROUP BY json_extract_scalar(payload, '$.productionCell')
ORDER BY work_orders_started DESC
